addWidgetIntro: Pick a tile to add to your dashboard. Resize and reorder it right on the page.
allAdded: Every widget is already on your dashboard.

askQuick.budgetPrompt: Am I on track with my budgets this month?
askQuick.goalPrompt: Help me plan a realistic savings goal.

emptyBody: Add a widget to see your money at a glance.
emptyLabels: Add labels to transactions to see this.
premiumNote: Premium tiles unlock with a Lite or Pro plan.
singleCurrency: All your money is in {{base}}. Add an account in another currency to see the split.
subsSpentNote: Spend so far is estimated from each subscription's price and how long it's been running. Actual charges may differ.

subscriptions.title: Track subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Netflix, gym, insurance — see what they quietly cost you each year.

budgets.title: Set a budget
budgets.body: Pick a monthly cap for eating out or shopping and watch it as you spend.

recurring.title: Automate repeat entries
recurring.body: Rent, salary, EMI — enter them once and they post themselves each month.

creditCards.title: Track your card cycle
creditCards.body: Add a statement day and see what's due before the bill arrives.

loans.title: Follow your EMIs
loans.body: Add a loan once and see the schedule, what's paid, and what's left.

goals.title: Save towards something
goals.body: Set a target and a date, and track how close you actually are.

splits.title: Split with friends
splits.body: Share a dinner or a trip, track who owes what, and settle over UPI.

receipts.title: Scan a receipt
receipts.body: Photograph a bill and it fills in the amount, date and line items.

investments.title: Track investments
investments.body: Add holdings to see them counted in your net worth.
